description: This PHP source file defines the ReviewListAPI class, which handles API requests related to retrieving a list of performance reviews in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for fetching review data with filtering, sorting, and pagination, and is part of the performance plugin's API module.

classes.name: ReviewListAPI
classes.description: Handles API endpoints for listing and managing performance reviews, including filtering, sorting, pagination, and authorization. Extends PerformanceReviewAPI and utilizes traits for authentication and service access.
